description: Deploying an AppHost with a Gateway that had no routes (or an Ingress with no paths) could make `aspire deploy` hang for around 15 minutes waiting on Kubernetes objects that were never created, and could leave TLS certificates stuck in a pending state. Route-less Gateways and path-less Ingresses are now consistently excluded from all TLS and deployment steps, and a clear warning names what was skipped.
name: Fix deployment hang from route-less Gateways and Ingresses
